desc:
🌊 Welcome to Survive The Tsunami!  🌊
PLAY WITH FRIENDS!

Build Bridges To Escape From Tsunami!

🎣 Sell Fish and Earn Cash
🪓 Chop Unique Trees
🌉 Build Bridges to New Islands
🏝️ Discover 10 Different Islands
⚒️ Unlock More Powerful Axes
🎒 Increase Your Backpack Capacity
🦝 Fight Off Attacking Raccoons
💰 Upgrade, Explore and Survive!

🌊 But watch out... A HUGE TSUNAMI IS COMING!
🚁 Reach the final island, get to the HELICOPTER, and escape before the tsunami destroys everything!

🏆 Can you discover all 10 islands and survive until the end?
